name: Jaya Ballard
description: Jaya Ballard is a pyromancer task mage from Terisiare and later a planeswalker, one of the oldest on Dominaria, known as a sarcastic fire mage and as Chandra's teacher.

summary.text: Jaya Ballard is a pyromancer task mage from Terisiare and later a planeswalker, one of the oldest on Dominaria, known as a sarcastic fire mage and as Chandra's teacher.

bio.text: In the Ice Age she and Jodah prevented a Knights of Stromgald attack on Darien, and she slew Balash Xev and exiled Marit Lage's ice into the Blind Eternities.

bio.text: Wearing a ring that carried Mairsil's mind, she was possessed, cut Jodah's throat and helped destroy Soldev and the School of the Unseen with war beasts.

bio.text: Jodah smashed his mirror in her face, which triggered her planeswalker spark, purged Mairsil and Lim-Dul from her, and let her stop the destruction.

bio.text: She gave Jodah an amulet and left Dominaria, and after visiting Regatha she returned two hundred years later to find a religion based on her and stayed there as Mother Luti.

"Jaya Ballard", section "Regatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When Chandra came to study under her, Jaya agreed to train her and later helped the Gatewatch against Bolas without taking their oath.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.
"Jaya Ballard", section "Meeting the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark she went to Ravnica with the Gatewatch, joined the failed attempt to assassinate Liliana, and was trapped by the Immortal Sun while fighting Bolas's Eternals.

citations.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria she fought Phyrexians at the Oyster Bay summit and elsewhere, and the compleated Ajani drove his axe into her and hurled her off the Mana Rig, killing her.

citations.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya Ballard prevent an attack by the Knights of Stromgald on Darien and reveal Lim-Dûl's involvement.
timeline.quote: prevented an attack on Darien's life by the Knights of Stromgald and revealed that Lim-Dûl was behind it

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah escapes with Jaya Ballard and they seek to unite Kjeldor with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: Jodah escaped with the aid of his old friend Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balash Xev leads her cult in Balduvia, mutating followers; he is slain by Jaya Ballard.
timeline.quote: He was slain by Jaya Ballard at the end of the Ice Age.

citation.text: "Marit Lage", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya confronts Marit Lage, then exiles the ice and Marit Lage into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: exiling it and Marit Lage into the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Marit Lage", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah leaves with Jaya Ballard to hunt Mairsil-Lim-Dûl's spirit, leaving Gerda in charge.
timeline.quote: Jodah left with Jaya Ballard to track down the remainder of Mairsil -Lim-Dûl's spirit and left Gerda in charge of the school.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard stops the destruction.
timeline.quote: was only stopped in the end by the newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya fails to steal from Jodah's chambers; sensing her magic he lets her study at the School of the Unseen, but she leaves to be a task mage.
timeline.quote: Sensing magical capabilities in her, Jodah allowed Jaya to study in the School of the Unseen at Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya finds Jodah missing and follows the trail to Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the trail led to Tresserhorn .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya rescues Jodah, who was drugged by Lim-Dûl, and summons Freyalise, promising her the school's resources for her World Spell.
timeline.quote: She destroyed the pollen-bearing flower and rescued him

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle Jaya defeats Chaeska with an unsummon and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand, unaware it bears Mairsil's ring.
timeline.quote: Jaya was successful in her battle and later claimed Lim-Dûl's severed hand as a battle trophy

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya guides a group into Yavimaya, defends the elves, helps cleanse the Heart of Yavimaya and helps birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child.
timeline.quote: helped to birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya leads mages who fail to protect Kelsinko from the rising seas.
timeline.quote: Jaya was the leader of a group of mages who tried to protect the city of Kelsinko

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and they search for the ring.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Jaya set out to search for the missing ring

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wearing the ruby ring, Jaya is possessed by Mairsil and cuts Jodah's throat, but Jodah survives and shatters his mirror in her face.
timeline.quote: She cut Jodah's throat, using his blood to revive the Phyrexian war beasts.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Her planeswalker spark flares, Jaya erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.
timeline.quote: Jaya's planeswalker spark flared.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya gives Jodah an amulet to keep him sane and long-lived and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She then departed Dominaria for the wider multiverse .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard rescues Jodah, and she calls upon Freyalise to cure him, putting them in the planeswalker's debt.
timeline.quote: Jaya called upon Freyalise to cure him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya warn Kjeld; the Knights of Stromgald's coup fails and King Darien is convinced.
timeline.quote: the threat convinced King Darien of the truth in Jodah's warnings

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya shows Jodah Lim-Dûl's severed hand with the ring finger missing and they set out to find the ring.
timeline.quote: the hand of Lim-Dûl and the ring finger were missing

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
timeline.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya ascends as a planeswalker and helps defeat the Beasts; Jodah chooses not to rebuild the School and hides behind legends.
timeline.quote: Jodah opted to spread rumors and lies about himself to hide behind myths and legends

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil's ring coerces Jaya into picking it up; the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys Soldev and the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.
timeline.quote: Jaya ascended and removed the minds of Lim-Dûl and Mairsil from herself.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya return in 2954 AR and destroy the Lord of Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: But Jodah and Jaya returned there in 2954 AR , and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard remarks that 'toast' is an appropriate description of Incinerate's effect.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."

citation.text: Incinerate (DCI Legend Membership, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya reveals Jodah is the real Jodah, drugged by Lim-Dûl, and they escape Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Jodah is not a summoned being but the real thing

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah goes mad; Jaya summons Freyalise, who explains his periodic madness and offers a cure for a price.
timeline.quote: Jodah goes completely mad

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya steals Jodah's mirror in Krov and learns Gustha and Gerda sold Jodah to Lim-Dûl; she cures Jodah with it.
timeline.quote: Gustha and her cousin Gerda Äagesdotter were the ones who sold out Jodah to the necromancer

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya discovers Avram Garrison's plot to overthrow King Darien and warns Varchild, Jodah and Gustha, who foil the coup.
timeline.quote: they manage to foil the coup

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final battle, Jaya defeats the zombie Belenda and Chaeska; Gustha is devoured by undead while Avram, distracting her, is killed by Varchild.
timeline.quote: Jaya fights and defeats Belenda Dannisdotter—now a zombie, and Chaeska

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise returns the mirror and planeswalks away; the planeswalkers leave and Jodah and Jaya wonder what the new world holds.
timeline.quote: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise gives Jodah his mirror back and planeswalks away.

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twenty years later Jaya shows Jodah the blackened hand of Dul, claiming to have found it in a Soldev market.
timeline.quote: She shows him the blackened hand of Dûl which she claims to have found in a market in Soldev .

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya find at Tresserhorn only Chaeska and her undead Lord of Tresserhorn, and Jodah notes the Bottomless Pit has disappeared.
timeline.quote: Jodah realizes this is a dead-end but does discover that the Bottomless Pit under Tresserhorn has disappeared.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya meet Lovisa's Balduvians, who say the Kjeldorans are raiding them, and Jaya takes Lim-Dul's finger from a shaman.
timeline.quote: Jaya sees one of the Balduvian shamans carrying Lim-Dûl's finger as a talisman

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Kjeld Jodah is attacked by a Phantasmal Fiend sent by Lim-Dul; Jaya falls ill.
timeline.quote: Then Jaya suddenly falls very ill.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Soldevi Sentry attacks Jodah and Jaya, and Jodah finds his mirror now magnifies spells.
timeline.quote: Jodah discovers that his mirror now not only reflects spells but also magnifies their force

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beneath Soldev, Lim-Dul reveals himself as Jaya, stabs Jodah in the throat, and uses his blood to activate the War Beasts, which destroy Soldev.
timeline.quote: There Lim-Dûl reveals himself: all this time he had been Jaya!

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
timeline.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen is mostly reduced to rubble; Gerda leads survivors east, Jaya leaves, and Jodah disappears from history.
timeline.quote: Jodah himself decides to disappear from the history books.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard jokes about pyroblast against water mages.
timeline.quote: "Just the thing for those pesky water mages."

citation.text: Pyroblast (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard offers toast.
timeline.quote: "Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"

citation.text: Pyrokinesis (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard jokes about Pyroblast and pesky water mages.
timeline.quote: Just the thing for those pesky water mages.

citation.text: Pyroblast (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard remarks on a lot of nuggets.
timeline.quote: That's a lotta nuggets.

citation.text: Chicken Egg (Unglued, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard transfers Fedor's sapience into the lhurgoyf, which vows to protect Balduvia's people while Fedor becomes feral.
timeline.quote: The lhurgoyf vows to protect the people of Balduvia to make amends for those it killed before.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Ach! Hans, Run! , by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard jokes about a toasted victim.
timeline.quote: Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description.

citation.text: Incinerate (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
timeline.quote: You're ready. You're her .

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard tells Chandra the hounds prefer setting people on fire.
timeline.quote: They much prefer setting people on fire.

citation.text: Karplusan Hound (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Chandra learns Jaya is her mentor Mother Luti and restores Multani's consciousness, persuading Jaya to help.
timeline.quote: Using some of Nissa's techniques, she restored Multani's consciousness.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya visits Regatha before the Mending, returns two hundred years later to find a religion based on her, and stays as Mother Luti; Chandra arrives later to study under her.
timeline.quote: chose to stay and nurture the community, posing as the elder Mother Luti

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Regatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Gideon with Jaya on a skyship; after helping defeat Belzenlok, Jaya agrees to help the Gatewatch against Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: She didn't take the oath, jokingly stating that she was "not a joiner".

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Meeting the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After her death Jaya is memorialized on Shiv with four white pyramids and an ever-burning flame.
timeline.quote: Jaya was memorialized on Shiv with four white pyramids

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Jaya, who has revealed she was posing as Mother Luti, and Jaya explains she went back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and guided it.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
timeline.quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
timeline.quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
timeline.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
timeline.quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers to take Jaya to the Academy in Tolaria West, and Jaya says she is not sure how back she is yet.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure just how back I am yet, if you know what I mean.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
timeline.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urborg's ash cloud comes into view on the horizon as the Weatherlight approaches.
timeline.quote: They were coming up on Urborg.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Bolas orders Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop the Chamber, stripping Jace of his Guildpact power and wrecking the embassy with Ajani, Chandra, Jaya and Karn inside.
timeline.quote: the Chamber was catastrophically damaged when Nicol Bolas ordered Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop it

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas saves Liliana from the assassination attempt by destroying the buildings under Jace's team.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien volunteer to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: Jace, Jaya, Teferi, and Vivien volunteered to assassinate Liliana.
